mapper.select: SELECT i.template_item_id,i.meal_plan_template_id,i.day_index,i.meal_slot_code,sm.meal_slot_name,i.sort_order,i.menu_id, m.menu_name,m.food_type,m.menu_type,m.menu_gubun,m.meal_plan_type,m.calories_per_serving,m.del_yn menu_del_yn FROM the_full_order.tb_meal_plan_template_item i JOIN the_full_order.tb_menu_master m ON m.menu_id=i.menu_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_meal_slot_master sm ON sm.meal_slot_code=i.meal_slot_code WHERE i.meal_plan_template_id=#{meal_plan_template_id} ORDER BY i.day_index,COALESCE(sm.display_order,i.meal_slot_code),i.sort_order
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM the_full_order.tb_menu_master WHERE menu_id=#{menu_id} AND del_yn='N'

SELECT SUM(budget_per_person) daily_budget,COUNT(*) main_meal_count, GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT(meal_slot_name,' ',ROUND(budget_per_person)) ORDER BY meal_slot_code SEPARATOR ' · ') breakdown FROM the_full_order.vw_account_meal_slot_budget WHERE account_id=#{account_id} AND meal_slot_code IN (0,2,5) AND budget_per_person IS NOT NULL
